protocol.signal: Measure changes in lower-face skin that disagree with nearby cheeks and upper face. Use exact native picture clocks and a 96 px eye registration. Exclude the mobile central lips and high-gradient or clipped skin pixels.
protocol.comparison: Measure luma/chroma patch contrasts on both sides of the lower face. Compare its temporal change against both neighboring windows and change among the corresponding three nearby control patches. The second arm additionally requires a similarly localized loss of relative fine-detail contrast. Neither detector sees another copy or audio.
protocol.windows: 8, 12, 16 or 20 native pictures bracketed by five measured pictures on each side inside a detected shot. Keep the strongest single interval. Fit a separate point on the third largest ordinary GRID response with minimum .035.
protocol.assessment: All 92 retained H.264 held deliveries from the frozen earlier roster, including both neural synthesis families. These clips have prior project exposure. No thresholds fit using held responses.
protocol.gate: At least four time-qualified LivePortrait edits across three groups and the timing-qualified MuseTalk edit, with time IoU at least 0.5. At least 70% neural and ordinary coverage. At most two ordinary alerts and none on hard cuts or unedited originals. No confidence change.
